commit.subject: LU-21089 utils: warn about thin pool geometry on md arrays
commit.message:
LU-21089 utils: warn about thin pool geometry on md arrays

The first partial write to a thin pool block after a snapshot
copies the whole block. On a parity md array the copy avoids parity
reads only when the block is a whole number of rows and kcopyd
copies it in one piece, and on raidkm only with rk_row_write set.

lctl snapshot create now checks this for LVM targets and warns when
the pool block is not a multiple of the array's optimal_io_size, when
dm_mod kcopyd_subjob_size_kb is smaller than the block and not a
multiple of a row of up to 1 MiB, or when rk_row_write is 0. It only
warns, since none of these affects the snapshot's data. Only the
block size is checked, not where the pool data starts.
